content.description: Illustration showing hands installing a rotor component with chamfered end facing front. Includes a separate detail view showing the chamfered 'Front' end of the component.

content.text: Install the rotor with the chamfered end facing toward the front.
Be sure the letters inscribed on the cam ring and rotor are matching.

content.description: Illustration showing hands installing vane plates into a circular housing component.

content.text: Install the vane plates with the round end facing outward.

content.description: Diagram showing a rectangular component with rounded end and hatched/shaded section, with arrows indicating 'Round End' and 'Outside' orientation.
Illustration showing hands installing rear plate and spring components onto a circular cam ring assembly.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Place the rear plate on the cam ring with the pin holes aligned with pins.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Place the spring on the rear plate.

content.description: Illustration showing hands assembling front and rear housing components, with alignment marks indicated. Shows reservoir tank installation.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Align the marks on the front and rear housing, and assemble them.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Install the reservoir tank in place and tighten the reservoir tank set bolts.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Finger tighten the front and rear housing mounting bolts.
